author: Mark Atwood
text: Broken into 8 child beads: JMAP-x2gd.86.1 is the canonical write on mail-server; .86.2-.86.8 are propagations to chat-server / calendars-server / tasks-server / contacts-server / filenode-server / metadata-server / sharing-server, each blocked on .86.1. The propagation pattern is mechanical (copy the canonical shape, adapt only for extension-specific cascade and SetErrorType content). This bead stays open as the tracker and will close when all 8 children close. Note: the JMAP-x2gd.59 bead remains blocked on this tracker (i.e. it will close when .86.2 lands).
